# 佛說罵意經

**ID:** T0732
**Volume:** T17
**Category:** 經集部類
**Original Category:** 經集部
**Byline:** 後漢 安世高譯
**Dynasty:** 東漢
**Date:** 148–170
**Juans:** 1

## Contributors
- 安清 (A000366)

## Summary (Ask Bunkankun 聞分館君)

T732 in one fascicle is one of the brief karma-and-mind doctrine sūtras carrying [安世高](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E5%AE%89%E4%B8%96%E9%AB%98)'s name in the Taishō. The title — *màyì* "reviling thoughts" — refers to the unwholesome mental act of reviling or cursing, treated here as one of the principal kinds of unwholesome action of the mind.

**Abstract**

The text addresses the karmic consequences of *màyì* — angry, reviling, cursing thoughts directed at others — as a particularly destructive kind of mental action. The Buddha exposits how thoughts of cursing and reviling, even when not expressed in speech, generate negative karma; how they corrode the practitioner's mental clarity; and how the cultivation of metta (*cí* 慈) and patience (*kṣānti* 忍) is the antidote. The text is a brief moral-psychological discourse in the early Chinese Buddhist register.

The thematic focus on the mind's role in karma — rather than on bodily action alone — is characteristic of the early Buddhist tradition's emphasis on *cetanā* (intention) as the primary source of karmic value. The text fits the broader pattern of [安世高](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E5%AE%89%E4%B8%96%E9%AB%98)-attributed and pseudo-[安世高](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E5%AE%89%E4%B8%96%E9%AB%98) sūtras that focus on mental cultivation and moral psychology, complementing his better-attested meditation translations (the *Ānbān shǒuyì jīng* T602, the *Yīnchírù jīng* T603).

The cluster of [安世高](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E5%AE%89%E4%B8%96%E9%AB%98)-attributed karma- and mind-doctrine sūtras: [KR6i0418](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6i/KR6i0418), [KR6i0423](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6i/KR6i0423), [KR6i0424](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6i/KR6i0424), [KR6i0425](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6i/KR6i0425), this work [KR6i0426](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6i/KR6i0426), [KR6i0427](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6i/KR6i0427), [KR6i0428](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6i/KR6i0428).
